what_to_detect: The inherent speed trigger fires. Forge writes it as a Mode$ LifeLostAll trigger (ValidPlayer$ Opponent, PlayerTurn$ True, ActivationLimit$ 1, speed below 4) on a runtime command-zone effect card with no script file, so its trigger record names no sidecar line and trigger_mode can read neither its Mode$ nor a keyword; its resolution (ChangeSpeed) holds a speed_changed event.
near_miss: The speed trigger evaluated and not fired: an opponent losing life on the player's own turn after the trigger already fired that turn or at speed 4, or on another player's turn.
record_fields: trigger record ability provenance (runtime effect card)
